question: Who among the following Delhi Sultanate rulers took the policy of ‘blood and iron’ to deal with the Mewati community?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Balban**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Balban** adopted the policy of 'blood and iron' to deal with the Mewati community during his reign.
 
• Balban was one of the most powerful rulers of the Delhi Sultanate and served as Sultan from 1266 to 1287.
 
• His policy was characterized by strict administration and military actions
